Name: MoreMultiplayerInfo
Author: CheesySteak
Description:
[list]
[*]Adds a list of the other players on the right side of the screen. 
[*]View Player Information (all updated in real-time!) such as: Inventory, Skill Levels, Current Location, Last Activity (including tool use, area changes, cutscenes, and more).
[*]Configurable Options to disable certain messages, hide stuff if playing single player, and toggle visibility of certain items in the player information screen.
[/list]
Source is available here: https://github.com/cheesysteak/stardew-steak

Manifest.Name: MoreMultiplayerInfo
Manifest.Description: Displays helpful information about the other players on the farm.
